method: Per axis, add one maximum legal command tick and three encoder counts to the CAL-064 soft following-error threshold, then round upward to 0.1 degree. Verify that a first feedback frame above the result triggers immediate TRACKING_ERROR with no dwell wait.
control_rationale: The hard threshold covers transition from near the soft boundary through one maximum legal command tick plus encoder margin, while remaining much tighter than the obsolete 25 degree placeholder.
